context_requirements: Expression of the drug-specific target (e.g., MRGPRX1) or dependence on the ion-transport pathway (ATP1A1) for survival
For ATP1A1-mediated effects, the cell must rely on the Na+/K+-ATPase for maintenance of ionic gradients; most cultured human lines do, but transcriptional consequences are minimal at 6-24 h
For MRGPRX1-mediated effects, the cell must express the receptor; MRGPRX1 is a primate-specific sensory neuron receptor not expected in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of a canonical transcriptional program (e.g., cholesterol synthesis, UPR, interferon, or cell-cycle arrest) at 6 or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression that are shared across multiple lines and absent with vehicle
Evidence of target engagement (e.g., ATP1A1 inhibition) producing a measurable transcriptional signature in these lines
